name: f3d
notes: 2026-11-01: Minimal 3D viewer with headless rendering on macOS; glTF, USD, STEP, OBJ and Gaussian splats.
2026-11-01: Triage: assess. Report rates it a strong candidate.
summary: A lightweight 3D viewer with CLI rendering and headless EGL builds, accepting many CAD and graphics formats. It is a quick route from model assets to review images or video, without building a scene in a full 3D package.
use_when: Render a broad set of 3D asset formats to review images
Use for quick asset inspection over opening Blender
avoid_when: Use Blender for authored scenes, materials, lighting or animation
Use a format-specific renderer when fidelity is uncertain

assessment.rationale: Official release page lists 4.0.1-RC1 dated 2026-10-30 and stable 4.0.0 dated 2026-10-20. F3D documentation advertises multiple supported platforms and formats.
